wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is a completely blank Carr 5-5-PG ruled sheet: no dates, no names, no amounts on any of its ~40 writing lines. Cover line 1 carries a handwritten '0' in the CUMULATIVE cell and blank LAST/THIS cells; the Gen-1 form prints NO schedule total (schedule_total null), so the cover line is the only anchor. First report of the 2010 cycle (signed April 5 2010), so THIS and CUMULATIVE coincide.

expenditures.detail: Single Form B row 225.00 equals cover line 3 THIS (225.00) and CUMULATIVE (225.00). Gen-1 form prints no schedule total. ANOMALY: the filer also wrote 225.00 in the TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT cell of line 3 on what is his first 2010 report; had that cell meant a real prior total the cumulative would be 450.00. Retained verbatim as printed; scored on the THIS==CUMULATIVE pair.

gates.page_subtotal: Gen-1 Carr form prints NO schedule totals on either Form A or Form B (the sheet ends with '(If additional space is needed, use blank paper ...)'), so no page-subtotal gate exists; the cover lines are the only anchors and both close.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py finds no reliable grid on these ruled-line (not boxed) sheets; counted ink by eye: p2 zero inked writing lines out of ~40; p3 one inked line out of ~40, immediately under the header rule.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 first-row crop (=last row, only row) at 1200 dpi renders '3-12-2010 / Washington County / Filing fee / 225 superscript-00'; control crop one row-pitch below (200 dpi y=227) renders an empty ruled line, no ink.
gates.balance_chain: DOES NOT CLOSE as printed: beginning (not a field on this form) + contributions 0 - expenditures 225.00 = -225.00, but cover line 4 CUMULATIVE balance is a handwritten '0'. The filer paid the 225.00 filing fee without recording any offsetting contribution and still declared a zero end balance. Both figures retained verbatim. No earlier 2010 filing by this filer is in this chunk, so no cross-filing cumulative chain could be run.

escalation_note: p3 amount cell at 1200 dpi (confirms 225 with superscript 00 over the rule); p3 control band one pitch below at 1200 dpi (empty); p1 cover anchor grid at 600 dpi (confirms the three 225.00 cells, the two written '0's on lines 1-2 CUMULATIVE and the '0' on line 4 CUMULATIVE).
notes: Generation 1 (Carr Printing 5-5-PG, cover cites Utah Code 17-16-6.5, the cover cites 'The law is also printed on page four of this report' but THIS PDF HOLDS ONLY 3 PAGES - the statute page was not scanned/retained; no data is lost by that). Chunk file says candidate 'Dennis Bruce Drake', office 'Commission Seat B': the cover's 'Full Name of Candidate' reads 'Dennis Bruce Drake' and 'Name of Office' reads 'Washington County Commission Seat B' - both AGREE. County office, in scope. Cover date 'April 5, 2010'; RECEIVED stamp APR 5 2010, Washington County Clerk-Auditor. Candidate home address, ZIP, home phone and business phone printed in the clear on the cover were discarded at read time per privacy rule.

expenditures.note: amount written as '225' with a superscript '00' over the rule -> 225.00 per the superscript-cents convention; date written '3-12-2010'
